ideas.hook: a lowercase q drawn as one loose pen loop, the stroke overshooting where it closes and running down into the tail
ideas.means: the q is the circle you draw around what matters in your notes — the decision, circled

review.reading: a handwritten lowercase q, one loose pen loop; risk: generic script letter or an @ sign unless the overshoot is distinctive

ideas.hook: a lowercase q whose tail ties one soft, loose knot at the bottom
ideas.means: the string tied round a finger — the follow-up nobody forgets

review.reading: a lowercase q with a soft knot tied in its tail; risk: knot reads as a pretzel or infinity loop if drawn too symmetric

ideas.hook: an empty chair pushed neatly in under the edge of a table, seen from the side
ideas.means: the meeting is over and your time is given back — the relief remote teams want

review.reading: a chair tucked under a table edge, side view; risk: furniture-store or desk-booking icon if drawn literally

ideas.hook: three flat river stones stacked in a small balanced cairn, the top one smallest
ideas.means: a trail marker left for whoever comes after — the record for those who weren't in the room; calm and balanced

review.reading: a zen stacked-stones cairn: spa, meditation and wellness-app cliché

ideas.hook: a relay baton mid-handoff: one short rounded bar passing from a curved hand-shape to another
ideas.means: follow-ups handed to the person who owns them

review.reading: two hands passing a rounded pill: a handshake/pharmacy reading, and a rounded bar on the no-list

ideas.hook: a round table seen from above with one seat-shaped notch missing from its rim
ideas.means: quorum — everyone at the table, Quorvo quietly taking the note-taker's seat

review.reading: a ring with a notch: Pac-Man, a letter C or a loading spinner

ideas.hook: a ribbon bookmark hanging from the bottom edge of a closed, square block
ideas.means: the place you'll come back to: the part of the meeting worth keeping

review.reading: a book with a ribbon: the bookmark/save UI icon and a notes-product object

ideas.hook: a door standing slightly ajar, a tall slab with a thin wedge of light at its edge
ideas.means: you can leave the meeting — someone is keeping the notes

review.reading: a door ajar: the exit / log-out UI icon

ideas.hook: the word quorvo in a soft lowercase serif whose q descender sweeps right into a long, calm underline under the whole word
ideas.means: underlined — what was decided, noted once and done

review.reading: a soft serif wordmark with a swash underline from the q; risk: common swash-underline wordmark trope, weak as a standalone icon

ideas.hook: the word quorvo in a humanist sans where the two o's are drawn as the same open hand-drawn circle, not quite closed
ideas.means: two notes circled in one hand — a human writing, not a machine

review.reading: the word quorvo with two matching hand-drawn open circles for the o's; risk: open circles read as loading spinners if too regular

ideas.hook: a low sun half-sunk below a straight horizon line, with a wide calm gap above
ideas.means: the workday ends on time; teams across time zones

review.reading: a sunset over a horizon: travel/solar/weather cliché

ideas.hook: a fountain-pen nib seen head-on whose slit and breather hole form a lowercase q
ideas.means: notes written for you, by a careful hand

review.reading: a fountain-pen nib: the note-taking/writing product-object cliché

ideas.hook: a tall cup of tea seen from the side, a single smooth steam curl rising and turning into a q
ideas.means: the quiet hour you get back instead of a meeting

review.reading: a steaming cup: café/coffee-shop logo cliché

ideas.hook: two heavy rounded pebbles resting against each other, one slightly larger, sharing a small gap of light between them
ideas.means: two people agreeing, quietly; calm weight, nothing urgent

review.reading: two leaning blobs: generic geometry, reads as pebbles/spa or an unfortunate bum shape

ideas.hook: the word quorvo in a calm sans where the r's arm runs on without a break into the left stroke of the v, one letter handing the line to the next
ideas.means: a follow-up handed on from the person who said it to the person who owns it

review.reading: the word quorvo in a plain sans with an r-v ligature; risk: the joined rv reads as a w ('quowo') or a kerning accident unless the hand-on is deliberate

ideas.hook: a small paper boat folded from one square, sitting level on a single flat line
ideas.means: what was decided, folded by hand and sent on its way — calm water, nothing left behind

review.reading: an origami paper boat on a line: a common send/launch and kids'-craft cliché

ideas.hook: a round, soft-edged wax seal pressed slightly off-centre into the corner of a folded square of paper
ideas.means: signed off: the meeting's outcome closed and sent, with consent

review.reading: a sealed envelope or certificate with a wax seal: the mail/document product object and a verified-badge icon

ideas.hook: the word quorvo drawn as one unbroken handwritten line with no pen lift, upright and unhurried like a signature
ideas.means: a careful human hand writing it all down; signed and settled

review.reading: a generic monoline script signature wordmark; one-unbroken-line overlaps knot's string territory and has no ownable form at icon size

ideas.hook: a coat hanging alone on a single wall peg, its shoulders drawn as one soft curve
ideas.means: you can go home: the meeting is handled

review.reading: a coat on a wall hook: a cloakroom/wardrobe icon, the furniture-scene hat/hook reading rejected in round 1
